mapper.insert: INSERT INTO job_interview_score(exam_year,position_code,department_name,position_name,min_interview_score,interview_candidate_count,source_file_name,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(#{examYear},#{positionCode},#{departmentName},#{positionName},#{minInterviewScore},#{interviewCandidateCount},#{sourceFileName},#{createdAt},#{updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE department_name=VALUES(department_name),position_name=VALUES(position_name),min_interview_score=VALUES(min_interview_score),interview_candidate_count=VALUES(interview_candidate_count),source_file_name=VALUES(source_file_name),updated_at=VALUES(updated_at)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM job_interview_score WHERE exam_year=#{examYear} AND position_code=#{positionCode}
SELECT FROM job_interview_score WHERE exam_year=#{examYear} AND position_code IN #{code}
SELECT FROM job_interview_score WHERE exam_year=#{examYear} ORDER BY position_code

SELECT p.id AS positionId,s.exam_year AS examYear,p.position_code AS positionCode,p.recruit_count AS recruitCount, s.min_interview_score AS minInterviewScore,f.exam_subject_group AS examSubjectGroup, f.major_restriction_type AS majorRestrictionType,f.major_domains AS majorDomains FROM job_interview_score s JOIN import_file i ON i.exam_year=s.exam_year AND i.status='IMPORTED' JOIN job_position p ON p.import_file_id=i.id AND p.position_code=s.position_code JOIN job_position_feature f ON f.position_id=p.id WHERE f.exam_subject_status='RECOGNIZED' ORDER BY p.id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM job_interview_score s WHERE s.exam_year=#{examYear} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM job_position p WHERE p.position_code=s.position_code)
